**Instructions.** Choose the single best answer (a–e) for each question. You may use a periodic table.
Solubility rules are **not** provided. Calculators are allowed. Answers are rounded to the precision shown.
Time yourself: aim to finish in 75 minutes or less.

**Answer sheet.** Print the bubble answer sheet (`CHEM1301/exam-prep/answer-sheet/answer-sheet.pdf`, landscape,
100% scale) and fill in one circle per question, rows 1–35 (A–E match choices a–e). Leave the rest blank.

```{=latex}
\needspace{9\baselineskip}
```
**1.** Which of the following is **NOT** one of the four driving forces that tend to make a chemical reaction occur?

```{=latex}
\begingroup\leftskip=1.5em
```
a)\ Transfer of electrons\
b)\ Formation of water\
c)\ Formation of a solid\
d)\ An increase in the total mass of the products\
e)\ Formation of a gas

```{=latex}
\par\endgroup\medskip
```

```{=latex}
\needspace{9\baselineskip}
```

d)\ Ag^+^(aq) + Cl^−^(aq) $\rightarrow$ AgCl(s)\
